name: dsh-mcp-panel
description: Management console for the official DSH MCP client: a /mcp command with health diagnostics, a Settings tab with approval-gated server CRUD and automatic backups, and a trial console over the official tool pipeline.
longDescription: 官方 DSH MCP 客户端的管理控制台：/mcp 健康诊断、设置页审批门禁的服务器增删改与自动备份、官方工具管线试调台。
